parameters.query: update research_runs set status='running', started_at=coalesce(started_at,now()), provider_versions=provider_versions || '{"intake":"wf01-v3"}'::jsonb where id=$1 and account_id=$2; update accounts set stage='researching', lifecycle=$3 where id=$2; select $1::uuid as run_id,$2::uuid as account_id,$4::text as website_url,$5::text as domain;
